results.original: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. Regularization helps it generalize beyond its training examples. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.
results.reconstruction: Regularization enhances generalization beyond training examples. Quantization reduces memory requirements after training. Retrieval augmented generation enables the use of external documents when answering questions. A small transformer uses self attention to process text and uses backpropagation to improve its predictions during training.
results.reason: The passage is constructed by directly mapping each relation from the input data to a declarative sentence. The 'enhances' relation between regularization and generalization becomes 'Regularization enhances generalization beyond training examples.' The 'reduces_memory' relation with its condition 'after training' becomes 'Quantization reduces memory requirements after training.' The 'enables' relation with condition 'when answering questions' becomes 'Retrieval augmented generation enables the use of external documents when answering questions.' The two 'uses' relations from 'small transformer' are combined into one sentence: 'A small transformer uses self attention to process text and uses backpropagation to improve its predictions during training,' preserving the specific conditions attached to each usage.

interpretation: Model-estimated claim fidelity, idea order, ROUGE-L F1 and word-count similarity. Components range from 0 to 1; the weighted final score ranges from 0 to 100. Summary statistics describe chunks; final_score compares the complete texts and is null when evaluation is incomplete. A single matched idea has order agreement 1; no matches have order agreement 0 unless both claim lists are empty. Keep evaluator model, prompts and metric version fixed across runs. These scores are not external factual verification.
